ModMetaData.name: Better ModMismatch Window
ModMetaData.author: Madeline
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces the mod mismatch dialog with a side-by-side comparison of the mods in your save and the mods running now. Added, removed, reordered and version-changed mods are colored and counted, with search and filters.
Version checking (Mod Settings): mod versions are recorded in the save and compared on load. Versions are read from About/Manifest.xml or the modVersion tag in About.xml. Mod authors: add either one to get version checking.
Source and issues: https://github.com/zzzz465/ModMisMatchFormatter
